jobs.title: Sales Engineer im Aussendienst - Elektroinstallation 100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

Are you ready to make an impact with your sales expertise? As a Sales Engineer for Electrical Installation, you will be the main point of contact for our customers in the field of electrical installation products – including power distributors, intercom systems, and switches & sockets. In this exciting B2B role, you will support electricians and planning engineers across the German-speaking part of Switzerland, actively contributing to the growth of sales and margins.

You will work in a hybrid model (field sales & home office) and report to the Sales Manager for Electrical Installations based in Baden (AG). With your technical know-how and passion for sales, you will build long-term, strategically important customer relationships and sustainably develop your sales territory.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid


They are mainly responsible for

  • Manage your sales region: Provide expert advice to electricians in your area, supporting profitable growth.

  • Acquire new customers: Identify market opportunities, win new clients, and ensure an outstanding customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Grow with the team: Collaborate closely with extended sales teams to explore new market opportunities and contribute innovative ideas.

  • Work in a structured way: Maintain your sales activities and project pipeline consistently in ABB’s CRM system (Salesforce) – transparent and goal-oriented.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in technical sales and business development

  • Good market knowledge in electrical installation and an interest in modern topics like building automation

  • Strong communication skills with proven ability to build and maintain successful customer relationships

  • Completed vocational training as an electrician or a technical university degree (e.g., electrical engineering)

  • Independent, structured working style combined with teamwork and customer orientation

  • Proficient in ERP and CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) as well as MS Office

  • Valid driver’s license category B and a valid work permit for Switzerland

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for
any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

jobs.title: Test Engineering Specialist (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and maintain test infrastructures and test automations in accordance with business strategy to improve safety, efficiency, quality, and cost reduction. Each day, you will ensure existing test systems remain functional and up-to-date while designing new automated solutions for emerging products. You will also showcase your expertise by implementing innovative testing methodologies that enhance production standards and reduce costs.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining and improving existing test systems, both hardware infrastructures and software automations, ensuring they meet current operational standards.

  • Designing new test systems for new products in compliance with specifications and manual test procedures, implementing automation wherever possible.

  • Providing support for the integration and startup of test systems, defining action plans and training relevant personnel.

  • Identifying and recommending opportunities for improving test processes and implementing related projects, ensuring adherence to safety requirements and evaluating new technologies.

• Qualifications for the role

  • You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in UPS testing or commissioning, with proven expertise in test system development and maintenance.

  • Highly skilled in hardware design and automation software development, with the ability to create robust and efficient testing solutions.

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of electrical infrastructures design and software development in C programming language.

  • You are passionate about workplace safety and technical documentation, ensuring all systems comply with safety requirements and are properly documented.

  • Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You are at ease communicating in English, both written and spoken.

  • Nice-to-have: Knowledge of programming languages such as LabVIEW, Python, and C#, experience with programming IDEs like LabWindows CVI and VSCode, and familiarity with hardware design software such as Altium.

More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for traction system customer projects. Each day, you will ensure the activities related to all engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by acting as a technical design authority for complete projects and drive the corresponding design and engineering activities.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Motion Business - Traction Division. Main stakeholders are product management, project management, R&D and production.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Technical lead of the project team of specialist engineers for complex engineering projects, in collaboration with the commercial project manager
  • Technical representation of the project towards the customer and suppliers
  • Ensuring project execution within the given time, cost, and scope framework
  • Drive decisions and maintain close collaboration with other engineering teams (locally and globally), R&D, product management, project management and other relevant functions
  • Actively promoting the application and continuous improvement of engineering practices and processes

Our team dynamics
You will join a high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor, Master or PhD in electrical, software or mechanical engineering
  • At least 5 years work experience in a technical customer focused area, ideally in the field of railway, E-bus or heavy electric vehicle propulsion
  • Technical Project management experience
  • Strong level of self-motivation, curiosity, and a structured approach to work
  • Team player with excellent communication skills in English and preferably in German
Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Canteen
  • Flexible work practices
  • on-site Gym

jobs.title: R&D (Senior) Scientist - Power Electronic Converters (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulating and optimizing power electronic topologies and converters for various applications including conducting broad system level studies.

  • Leading and participating in converter design projects in collaboration with the business while mentoring juniors.

  • Designing, implementing, and testing converter prototypes in the lab.

  • Driving innovation by developing new power electronic concepts and solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD with emphasis on power electronics converter design, optimization, and prototyping. Additional relevant industrial experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on laboratory skills, a willingness to work independently and take initiative in designing, building, and testing converter prototypes. A broader set of skills is expected.

  • Experience with setting-up converter testing by means of circulating power in a back-to-back configuration will be advantageous.

  • Experience in design, commissioning and testing of medium voltage and 3-phase grid connected inverters/rectifiers will be advantageous.

  • Experience in applied control theory including hardware implementation of control for power electronic systems can be advantageous.

  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer, French Fluency Required (80–100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

  • Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Spend approximately 80% of your time on site with customers, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Technical Consulting: Advise customers on electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV) and present solutions tailored to their technical and business requirements.

  • Value Communication: Clearly communicate the benefits of our products, including improved energy efficiency and reduced CO₂ emissions.

  • Relationship Management: Build trust, identify key stakeholders, and strategically position our solutions.

  • Market & Industry Awareness: Monitor trends in the drives and motion industry and contribute innovative ideas.

Your • Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical training in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in sales, with strong knowledge of electric motors and variable frequency drives (LV & MV).

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Our mission is to be a trusted expert in automated industrial systems, with a strong focus on reliability, long‑term partnerships, and a deep understanding of our customers’ needs.

The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer - Cobot-Distribution & Ecosystem (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


In this role as a Sales Engineer for Collaborative Robotics, you will take charge of selling ABB’s advanced robots across Switzerland. Your primary focus will be on engaging with a diverse range of customers, from small and medium enterprises to regional global companies, to cultivate business opportunities in the growing field of collaborative robotics. We are looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset, a passion for sales, and a practical approach to identifying and pursuing market opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Robotics & Discrete Automation Business Area in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Increasing sales volume and margin across the ABB Robotics Cobots portfolio while establishing and maintaining effective customer relationships through reliable service and a deep understanding of customer needs and ABB solutions.

  • Preparing sales plans and bids, managing key accounts (particularly in the consumer industry), and providing customers with tailored products, solutions, and services that align with volume, mix, and profitability targets.

  • Identifying and developing new market opportunities, monitoring customer and market trends, and collaborating with the Marketing team to create effective marketing activities. Furthermore, monitoring competitor activities, implementing appropriate response strategies, and sharing market intelligence insights with the Marketing and Sales organization.

  • Managing and expanding the partner network, ensuring efficient coordination of sales activities and transactions, and analyzing data to meet business objectives.

• Qualifications for the role

  • You are skilled in working with CRM tools such as SAP and SalesForce, with experience in the collaborative robotics market.

  • You have established skills in technical sales support, with first years of experience working in robotics or a related field.

  • You possess enhanced knowledge of customer relationship-building methodologies and are proficient in analyzing market trends and competitor activities.

  • You are passionate about customer-focused problem-solving and innovative thinking, paired with proficient organizational skills.

  • Degree in Engineering, Robotics, Business Administration (with technical focus), or equivalent professional experience in a technical environment.

  • You are proficient in communicating fluently in both English and German, ensuring clear and effective interactions.

  • Willingness to travel up to 60%, balancing onsite collaboration with virtual engagement to optimize customer relationships.

Benefits

  • Remote work & flexible work schedules

  • Minimum 27 days of vacation

  • Gym subscription

  • ABB Childcare Centers

  • Development opportunities

More about us

ABB’s Robotics Division is a pioneer in robotics and digital services, providing innovative solutions for a diverse range of industries, from automotive to electronics to logistics. Our intelligent robotics solutions support businesses well beyond traditional manufacturing, increasing productivity and flexibility in high-growth segments including healthcare, logistics, food and beverage, construction, and retail, including ecommerce.​

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end planning and management of inventory, ensuring an efficient flow from purchase requisition through to customer invoicing and delivery execution. A strong focus will be placed on planning activities, including order portfolio management, inventory optimization, replenishment strategies, and the definition of inventory parameters and targets to guarantee material availability and service level performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the IPU in Quartino, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are the P&F, OP&L, Logistics, IPU Stand Alone, Modular and B&S.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining inventory policies based on specified segmentation, including ABC/XYZ analysis to optimize inventory strategies, stock levels, and service performance in terms of ROTD

  • Calculating and maintaining the inventory parameters, including safety stock, reorder point, lot size, lead time, and replenishment strategies, in SAP

  • Coordinating material planning with call-offs to ensure that purchase requisitions are converted into purchase orders in collaboration with operations, buyers, and services

  • Collaborating with buyers to achieve the best possible supplier performance in terms of supplier on-time delivery, Minimum Order Quantity, quality, lead time, and flexibility

  • Demonstrating solid knowledge of logistics flows and operational dynamics to ensure efficient material availability, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain coordination


• Qualifications for the role:

  • +5 years of experience in material planning

  • Degree in Management Engineering/Economics as a preferred qualification

  • Good skills in data analysis, structured thinking, teamwork, and communication

  • Profound knowledge in SAP MM/PP, MS Excel, and Power BI

  • Fluency in Italian and English

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed.

The recruiting process is being led by Pedro Labián, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

jobs.title: Global Head of Quality, Motion Traction (Location: Europe)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Operations Manager

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a new Global Head of Quality for our Motion Traction Division.

This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Motion Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, and Poland.

The work model is hybrid and regular presence in our factories and suppliers' location will be expected, with the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

#LIhybrid

To support the continued growth of our Motion Traction business and the increasing expectations of our customers, we are looking for a Global Head of Quality who will elevate quality into a true source of competitive advantage across our global organization.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a technical quality leader who wants to shape the future of quality in a complex, engineered-to-order environment. Beyond defining strategy, you will be expected to build a lasting quality culture, one that is owned by every function, every site, and every team involved in delivering reliable, high-performance solutions to our customers.

As a member of the divisional leadership team, you will lead a global network of quality professionals and act as a key connector across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Project Execution, and Customer-facing teams. You will bring people together around a shared ambition: preventing issues before they occur, solving problems at the root cause, and continuously raising the standard of performance across the full value chain.

This role calls for a leader who combines strong technical credibility with the ability to influence, engage, and mobilize people in a global matrix organization. You will need to move confidently between strategic transformation and operational detail, from quality governance, supplier performance, and closed-loop quality systems to shopfloor engagement, customer feedback, and data-based decision making.

Success in this role will depend on your ability to create ownership rather than control. You will empower teams to identify risks early, strengthen prevention over detection, and embed accountability for quality into everyday decisions. By doing so, you will help build a culture where quality is not a department or a process, but a mindset that enables customer trust, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

For a technical leader who is motivated by impact, complexity, and global collaboration, this is an opportunity to shape quality at scale, driving measurable improvement today while building the capabilities, systems, and culture that will define the future of Motion Traction.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the global quality strategy in line with business priorities, ABB quality standards, and QMS requirements.

  • Lead the global Quality organization and strengthen a consistent, prevention-focused quality culture across regions.

  • Build and sustain a robust closed-loop quality process from product development through customer feedback.

  • Drive global standards for supplier quality, production quality assurance, testing, and outgoing inspection.

  • Lead data-driven quality governance, including analytics, risk identification, non-conformance management, and prevention initiatives.

  • Partner with Engineering, R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer teams to resolve issues systematically, prevent recurrence, and improve quality performance.

  • Oversee global quality processes, audits, governance models, and continuous improvement frameworks.

  • Embed quality early in product and process development through structured planning, APQP/PPAP where applicable, and proactive risk detection.

• Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, or Operations within complex industrial or engineered-to-order environments.

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience will also be considered.

  • Proven record of driving quality improvement, leading structured problem solving, and using data to improve business performance.

  • Strong expertise in quality systems, QMS governance, root cause analysis, 8D, and Lean, ideally gained in automotive, rail, or heavy equipment environments; APQP, PPAP, DFMEA, and PFMEA knowledge is a strong advantage.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a global matrix organization.

  • Familiarity with IRIS, EN/IEC standards, and regulatory requirements related to traction or railway applications is an advantage.

  • Proven experience leading teams, developing (seasoned) people, and creating a positive, collaborative environment that supports engagement, accountability, and high performance.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in English

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% globally.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role, location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.


ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing, and circular solutions for customers, industries, and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences

jobs.title: Project Engineer (80%-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

What We Offer

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation

  • Flexible working models (hybrid)

  • Comprehensive further training and development opportunities

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration

  • Occupational social benefits and employee discounts

More About Us

ABB is a leading technology company that stands for a sustainable and high-performing future. Our solutions are active in the areas of electrification, automation and digitalization and help transform the way we live and work. Visit www.abb.com for more information about our solutions worldwide.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced R&D Senior Engineer with focus on Quality and Reliability to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D Power Electronics center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer will have special focus on performing theoretical and experimental reliability analysis at components, sub-assemblies and at a system level, as well as linking the findings to the Quality assurance plans with special emphasis to the identified critical elements and their critical to quality parameters from the design phase to the ramp-up of the production and the life cycle management of the SST products. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with future relocation possibilities to other production locations.

The main responsibilities include

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the reliability analyses and assessment for Power Electronics Components (e.g. semiconductors, control HW, capacitors, fans, etc.), assemblies, and subsystems utilizing statistical methods and tools for reliability prediction and modelling (MTFB/ FIT). This is to be performed in close collaboration with the R&D team, including the identification risks and defining the corresponding mitigation actions and reliability design guidelines through tools such as Failure Modes and Effect Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, Physics of Failure methodologies, electrical, mechanical and thermal stress analysis, test data review and assessment and reference to relevant industry standards.

  • Lead the reliability plans and quality requirements including internal and suppliers’ reliability and quality testing plans as well as supporting the internal quality assurance actions involving the internal supply chain management, production and operation teams. This includes the identification of patterns and trends related to reliability, quality and performance from internal and external reliability testing and production data as well as root case analysis and corrective and preventive actions for issues identified during the R&D Validation and Qualification phases, Production and Field Operation.

  • Provide close support and collaboration with the productization and operations teams for the SST product quality assurance plans development and maintenance for mass production and fleet performance tracking. This includes internal and external audits, routine and screening testing activities, Statistical Process Control monitoring, documentation management and quality KPIs definition, monitoring and reporting to ensure product conformity and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Actively contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team with focus on robust design for reliability and quality assurance.

You will be part of advanced R&D and productization activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and stakeholders in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University Master’s degree / PhD in the field of engineering (electrical, mechatronics, etc.), or Equivalent Experience in the field of reliability and quality engineering with focus on Power Electronics products. Experience in the field of Medium Voltage and High Power converters is a plus.

  • Solid background know-how and expertise in Reliability analysis, testing and assessment, with direct impact to product design, production quality plans and mitigation actions identification applying state of the art reliability and quality tools and methods.

  • Experience and high interest in theoretical and practical reliability and quality assurance activities related to Power Electronics products development and lifecycle management for mass production, including interaction and communication with different stakeholders.

  • Interest in applied research and product development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

  • Availability to travel sporadically.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid.

The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is being led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

jobs.title: Senior Robotic Middleware Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


In this role, you will act as a key technical contributor to the base software platform of our products. You will apply your expertise to make sure our algorithms are supplied with fresh sensor data and can run without interruptions, even in the toughest conditions. Your work will glue all pieces of software together and make our robots operate robustly in real-world environments.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-hybrid


This role is contributing to the Sevensense by ABB team as part of ABB Robotics in Switzerland and Spain. You will work closely with all software teams at Sevensense to make sure our algorithms reliably execute on our own hardware products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Designing and implementing the robotics middleware that connects all our sensors and algorithms together.

  • Making sure your fellow developers have the tools to record, visualize and introspect our robotic systems.

  • Ensuring a healthy robot system that can be easily debugged across releases.

  • Improving the stability and reliability of our robots such that they can work 24/7 without interruption to make our customers happy.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering and a degree in Computer Science, Robotics or related field.

  • Track record in writing solid production Python and C++ code and bonus points for Rust or the willingness to learn Rust.

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist for EMC in Power Electronics
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: R&D Associate Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the strategic technology direction by contributing your own ideas for identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative technology, and solutions.

Reporting to the CoE Team Leader, you will supports the R&D Agile Team’s by performing assigned tasks under supervision and execute assigned tasks using technical knowledge in a structured way.

You will also showcase your expertise by staying abreast of the state of the art and actively applying this knowledge. Main stakeholders are all Critical Power Agile teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Functional & Performance Testing by Measuring parameters like efficiency, power factor, switching times, voltage drops, and insulation resistance.

  • Validate product safety, robustness through accelerated stress testing and failure analysis, executing Highly Accelerated Life Testing

  • Conducting temperature-rise tests (heat run tests) using thermocouples and thermal cameras to identify hotspots under nominal and overload conditions

  • Documenting work and contributing to written technical reports

  • Using technical know-how in your own area of competence to solve problems.


You will become part of a high-performing, collaborative team of experts, dedicated to delivering the highest quality standards in electrotechnical validation


• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum few years of experience working as Laboratory Specialist with UPS equipment’s or equivalent related experience.

  • Sound knowledge in Electrical Engineering for power converter platforms as a preference

  • A solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills

  • A university degree in electronic engineering (Bachelor's degree)

  • Fluent command of Italian and good knowledge of English (German is a plus)

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Engineering Change Manager Service
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure that change notifications by the Agile teams of the UPS product lines consider the serviceability of the products. You will engage with the change managers of the Agile teams and the stakeholders within Service on a daily basis.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team in Quartino. The main stakeholders include change managers from the Agile teams of the UPS product lines in Quartino, service professionals responsible for technical support, documentation, and spare parts, as well as supply chain specialists responsible for spare part creation and stock management.

You will join a newly formed Service Engineering team, where you will have the opportunity to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing new ECN (engineering change notices) for potential impact on Service
  • Maintaining a tracker for ECN potentially affecting Service
  • Run the meetings where Service stakeholders discuss ECN impact and suggest changes to the change leaders
  • Track the updates to the ECN based on Service stakeholder consensus and approve acceptable ECN
  • Track the execution of Service implementation of the ECN (Service News, Spare part (list) updates, information to global technical support)
  • Providing technical support and solving problems in own expertise area via remote or on-site service in any Service category
  • You will support the change managers pro-actively to improve the correctness, completeness, and effectiveness of the Service aspects of the ECN

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • At least 5 years of experience in similar roles, or 10 years of experience in UPS development or service roles
  • Experience with the product lines manufactured in Quartino
  • Experience with change management process and related documentation
  • Experience in the Windchill change management system
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset

jobs.title: R&D Senior Engineer Firmware (80 -100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Chapter Leader (Control Firmware)


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

Work model: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity.

  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications.

  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python/assembler backed by solid computer science fundamentals.

  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems.

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of development infrastructure: Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools.

  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, IEC61850, Profibus, CAN bus) are a plus.

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist in Converter-Based Distribution Systems (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems


Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovations at the intersection of power electronic converters and microgrid integration, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on converter operation, intelligent protection coordination, load sharing, and stabilizing control strategies. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems - generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that power ABB's product portfolio.

Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through power converter-based distribution systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to welcome you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Pioneer innovative concepts in power electronic converter-based, low voltage and medium voltage, AC and DC distribution systems.
  • Conduct detailed simulations, algorithm development, and laboratory experiments and publish research findings and patent innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with global, multidisciplinary teams of scientists at ABB Research.
  • Work closely with ABB business units to transition research into real-world applications, including data centers, integration of renewables, industrial electrification, e-mining, and marine systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering with specialization in power electronics, power systems, or control.
  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents.
  • Deep technical expertise in:
    - Power electronic converter topologies, modulation and control concepts
    - Interactions between converters, passive components, and protection devices
    - Microgrid modeling, optimization and stability analysis.
  • Hands-on laboratory skills with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing converter systems and protection schemes. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


Important remark: This position is open for ongoing talent sourcing; while we are not actively hiring for this role at the moment, we welcome applications to build our future talent pipeline.

Your role and responsibilities:

You will be responsible for sales of electrification, low voltage, and control products in the automation and machine manufacturing segment for the Swiss OEM market, ensuring growth in sales volumes and margins. Reporting to the Head of Sales OEM Electrification, you will leverage your expertise to build lasting customer relationships through outstanding service.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive sales by managing existing accounts, acquiring new customers, and collaborating with marketing, technical support, and sales teams to develop sales plans and identify market opportunities.

  • Leverage your knowledge of customers’ applications and ABB solutions to address needs, focusing on digitalization, Industry 4.0, and energy efficiency, ensuring technical and financial accuracy.

  • Partner closely with ABB distribution channels to enhance customer journey and maintain precise customer data within the CRM system (Salesforce).

  • Continuously expand your technical expertise, monitor market trends, and apply diverse sales techniques such as value-based selling to maximize business success.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical sales

  • Strong technical expertise in low voltage products, with a solid understanding of the Swiss industry and automation.

  • Proficiency in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; experience with order development tools (ERP) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, paired with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

  • Technical qualification, preferably a bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Valid Swiss driver’s license and work authorization in Switzerland.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

A Future Opportunity
Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.
